PROPOSITION: The UK should protect employees from workplace dismissal due to social media backlash unrelated to their job performance.

OPINION PARAGRAPH: I cannot say without knowing more information if a person should be protected from workplace dismissal due to social media backlash if it is not related to their job performance as there could be several other factors that should be taken into consideration.  We don't know if the person has committed a crime, whether they have made racist remarks, whether it is hate crime, whether they have done something sexually wrong or what.  Therefore there is not one case that fits all.  This would need to be looked at as a much wider picture as social media backlash could be for something really simple - like showing a meal that hasn't been cooked very well and would not be relevant to something far more serious.
